action.decision_reason: Discovery cycle requires regenerating from GMC-screened parents after screening; gmc_guided_generation_needed is true and strong GMC parents exist, so generate gmc-guided structures before any further screening or MC request.

action.hypothesis: The top GMC-screened design d7d960548ee7 (lowest GMC risk 0.076, far_mean 0.000172, far_cvar90 0.000633, far_max 0.000919, worst_sector_mean 0.000341) will reproduce its strong sub-baseline far-field and tail behavior under unbiased Monte Carlo with 95% interval separation from baseline.
action.expected_observation: Unbiased-MC far_mean, far_cvar90, far_max, and worst_sector_mean for d7d960548ee7 across 4 replicates with 95% CIs separated from the baseline values, yielding a candidate-minus-baseline z <= -1.96 and passing the verifier relative-risk threshold 1.0.
action.decision_reason: The GMC-guided discovery gate is satisfied (12 GMC-screened >= 10, 4 GMC-guided-and-screened >= 4, mc_discovery_gate_passed true), so per the required cycle I now spend physical certification on the strongest GMC-screened candidate rather than over-breeding; d7d960548ee7 dominates every GMC metric and is the best use of the limited exact-candidate budget.

The GMC-guided discovery cycle is complete with 12 GMC-screened designs (gate >=10) and 4 GMC-guided screened designs (gate >=4).

action.hypothesis: d7d960548ee7 is the strongest verified absorber layout discovered within the fixed 7x7, 11-absorber inventory; its GMC-guided relocation of absorbers into high-leakage-path cells produced a large, statistically separated far-field improvement that reproduces under unbiased Monte Carlo.
action.expected_observation: The independent verifier accepts the verified_improvement claim for d7d960548ee7 based on the existing unbiased-MC certification and satisfied GMC discovery gates.
action.decision_reason: The Monte Carlo root-history budget is fully exhausted (0 remaining), so no further unbiased certification is executable; all required evidence for a verified_improvement claim already exists, and additional GMC screening or generation cannot be converted into new physical certification.

objective.mc_role: unbiased physical certification for selected structures
objective.fom_role: verification efficiency only; never the shielding objective
